title: 第十二章 鬼衣守卫 不死不灭第十三章 擒奸摘伏 喋血教场
content_zh:
台下众人叫骂声又起。万远泊擦了擦额头的冷汗，扶着台柱慢腾腾地立起身来。他上下打量着这位怪人，暗下思忖着他的来历。然而，半响过后，万远泊见其既不动手也不言语，心下更是疑惑，于是双手抱拳作礼问道：“阁下可有请柬？如若是远方来客，远泊有照顾不周的地方，还请见谅！但你若不是我万家请来的宾客，那还请阁下速速离开！”此话说得不卑不亢，一身凛然。而黑衣人却不答话，不知道他究竟想要干嘛。而众人也盯着这位怪人，猜想着他为何要来此搅场。
突然“噗”、“噗”。。。连着十声怪异的响声。只听教场外围的人群中传来阵阵惊叫声。定睛望去，人群之中的空地上，已有数处开始抖动摇晃起来，慢慢地形成了数个小型的突起。紧接着，从突起的地砖缝隙间，喷出了丝丝黑气，缭绕弥漫，愈聚愈多。而外围看热闹的百姓只顾尖叫着、逃窜离开。那黑气愈来愈重，汇成数个浓浓密密的气团。随后数团黑气又渐渐化作人形，显现出本来面目。其外形竟与台上鬼衣一模一样！周身裹着黑色斗篷，一顶帷帽遮面，无手无脚，行动机械，共有十个。十个鬼衣守卫每隔百步将教场团团围住。
“幽冥鬼府！”人群之中有人一眼识出！闻听此声，众人骇然，唏嘘声响起一片！要知道，幽冥鬼府可是邪道一霸。当今武林，除了三大正道门派：武当、万佛门、古剑盟，再没有任何一个帮派，敢直面站出来与之为敌！
万远泊冷哼一声，说道：“我万某虽武功不及于你，但也不是贪生怕死之徒！今日你要拿走锦王，我第一个不答应！”说罢，他扬起袖摆，左手握拳杵在腰口，右手伸掌探出，做了个请势！而鬼衣却摇摇头，蔑声说道：“你还不值得我动手！”话音刚落，外围一个鬼衣守卫如同利箭一般直直射向当场！
万远泊见其装扮与台上怪人无异，便话不多说，沉声一吼，一招【饿虎扑兔】直朝黑衣守卫面门抓去，黑衣守卫一挪一转，已然避开来招。随后，只见黑衣守卫的那件空荡荡的斗篷里突地幻生出手脚，顺势回了一招极为寻常的【神龙摆尾】。二人登时激斗起来。
万远泊的【海砂铁爪】气势磅礴，每招每势，均是虎虎生风，力大招沉。他一身横练的武功，配合到双手十指的狠招，使将出来虽然四平八稳，不见特色，但他双爪的锋锐无比让其招式顿增凌厉！众人无不喝彩助威。
而黑衣守卫却以轻捷灵动见长，只见他身影飘忽而至，飘忽而去，并不和万远泊死缠蛮打，而是间歇递上一两手快招，但这已教万远泊略显手忙脚乱。数十招一过，台下众人已是心中有数。一看便知黑衣守卫的功夫高出甚多，犹如戏耍耗子似地存心戏弄。
万远泊身历险境，自然心知。但是此人个性刚毅，一想到今日锦王若被掳去，万家蒙羞，颜面无存，又岂能知难而退。随即加紧手上劲力，一爪一拳舞得如疯如狂，也不顾自身要害只是埋头抢攻。
不觉间，两人已拆到五六十招，万远泊尽管攻势刚猛，却始终无法奈何黑衣守卫的轻捷灵动。便连黑衣守卫的衣衫也难以碰着一块，心下生寒，莫要说今日救下锦王，恐怕连自家性命也得赔上。
焦灼的万远泊满头是汗！所谓打蛇不死，自贻其害。既然横竖是死，只得投之亡地然后存，置之死地然后生，倘若侥幸落个两败俱伤也不枉此生！
万远泊心下已做了最坏的打算！他自知今日刃侵于胸，火逼于肌，倒心定气宁下来。出手没有了起初的那么急躁。万远泊身为海砂帮帮主，武功虽然不高，但见识却非凡，对于其他帮派的步法招式，颇有自己的理解。他与黑衣守卫已过数十招，冷静地记下了黑衣守卫的步法身形。然后他看准黑衣守卫攻势，故意卖下一个破绽，装作精疲力竭，堪堪退步。
然而，黑衣守卫却也中招，视若无物地向万远泊怀间扑来。万远泊暗一咬牙，双爪翻出，力劲刚猛，左右爪齐齐抓向鬼衣守卫的肩部。“嘭”地一声，一丝黑气被挤压出来，鬼衣守卫的左右两肩却突然塌下！万远泊的两爪如同抓住了一块正泄气的布袋一般！
万远泊一得手哪肯停下，他只一愣神，便加重了力道，蛮力挤压！“哧、哧。。。”黑气逐渐散去，万远泊左爪竟然透过黑色斗篷触碰到了自己的右爪。而那件毫无生气的黑衣斗篷耷拉下来，只留下了十个窟窿。台下众人无不欣喜若狂！齐声叫好！
得意洋洋的万远泊抓起毫无生气的“黑色斗篷”，冲着台上的鬼衣微微一笑。但令人惊愕的事情发生了，万远泊只觉脚底忽地颤抖开来，“噗”地一声脚下裂开一道缝隙，还没来得及他多想，一团黑气分作两股，自他左右腿缠绕而上！
“啊！”万远泊一声惊叫，随即跪倒在地，一行血水顺着他的裤脚淙淙流出！原来他的双腿已被弄断！随后那团黑气，自行钻入了散落在地的黑衣斗篷，再次化做人形！然后他慢慢悠悠地飘荡过来，立在万远泊面前。只见那鬼衣守卫冷哼一声，俯身扯了扯斗篷的肩部，而那十个爪印赫然在目！
万远泊抬起头，惊恐地向黑洞洞的面纱里看去。只见黑纱映衬的帷帽里面，两只白色大眼突地一亮！随即两双鬼爪猝地从黑衣斗篷里探将出来，快速地夹住了万远泊的两只手腕！万远泊只觉得自己的手指如同十枝铁笔，且燥热如火，心下不犹一惊，正想沉肘甩开鬼衣守卫的双爪，即听得“喀嚓”一声，腕骨已被鬼衣守卫硬生生捏碎。
虽然手腕已断，但万远泊仍是强忍疼痛，怒吼一声，右手半拳半爪，蛮力往黑衣守卫的太阳穴击去。黑衣守卫早已看出他必有此招。一笑闪开，紧接着右脚踹出，正踢在万远泊的肚腹。众人立见一具庞大的身躯，直飞出台外。
“嘭”的一声，万远泊趴在地上，海砂帮十多名帮众慌忙上前扶起，只见万远泊身子垂软，脸色惨白，一口鲜血喷在地上，敢情胸前肋骨已断了数根，并已伤及内脏！“噗！”万远泊又一口鲜血相继喷出，然后他两眼一翻，头一歪，已然断了气息！
鬼衣朝手下点点头，微微一笑。然后踱步说道：“鬼衣守卫，魔棺孕育，怨气所结，不死不灭！”
content_en:
Everyone in the audience started shouting and cursing again. Wan Yuanbo wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and stood up slowly while holding on to the pillar. He looked this strange man up and down, secretly thinking about his origins. However, after a while, Wan Yuanbo saw that he did not move or speak, and he was even more confused, so he clasped his hands and saluted and asked: "Do you have an invitation? If you are a visitor from afar, please forgive me if Yuanbo has not taken care of me well! But if you are not a guest invited by my Wan family, then please leave quickly!" These words were neither humble nor arrogant, and he was awe-inspiring. But the man in black didn't answer, not knowing what he wanted to do. And everyone was staring at this weirdo, wondering why he came here to stir up trouble.
Suddenly "poof", "poof". . . Ten weird noises in succession. I just heard screams from the crowd outside the teaching field. Looking closely, several places in the open space among the crowd began to tremble and sway, slowly forming several small protrusions. Immediately afterwards, traces of black air spewed out from the gaps between the protruding floor tiles, lingering and gathering more and more. But the people watching the excitement on the periphery just screamed and ran away. The black air became heavier and heavier, forming several dense air masses. Then several groups of black energy gradually transformed into human forms, showing their true colors. Its appearance is exactly the same as the ghost clothes on stage! Wrapped in a black cloak and covered with a curtain, they have no arms or legs and move mechanically. There are ten of them in total. Ten guards in ghost clothes surrounded the teaching ground every hundred steps.
"Netherworld Ghost Mansion!" Someone in the crowd recognized it at a glance! Hearing this sound, everyone was shocked and booed! You know, Netherworld Ghost Mansion is the tyrant of evil. In today's martial arts world, except for the three major righteous sects: Wudang, Wanfo Sect, and Ancient Sword Alliance, no other gang dares to stand up and become their enemy!
Wan Yuanbo snorted coldly and said: "Although I, Wan, am not as good as you in martial arts, I am not greedy for life and fear of death! Today you want to take King Jin away, and I will be the first to refuse!" After that, he raised his sleeves, clenched his left hand into a fist at his waist, and extended his right hand to make a gesture of invitation! But Guiyi shook his head and said scornfully: "You are not worthy of my action!" As soon as he finished speaking, a guard in ghost clothes from the outside shot straight towards the spot like a sharp arrow!
Wan Yuanbo saw that his attire was no different from that of the weirdo on the stage, so he didn't say much, roared in a deep voice, and used a move [Hungry Tiger Pounces Rabbit] directly towards the face of the black-clothed guard. The black-clothed guard moved around and avoided the incoming move. Then, the empty cloak of the guard in black suddenly appeared with hands and feet, and he responded with the extremely ordinary [Dragon Tail Swing]. The two immediately started fighting.
Wan Yuanbo's [Sea Sand Iron Claw] is majestic. Every move and every move is like a tiger that generates wind, and a powerful move that makes it sink. His martial arts skills are combined with the ruthless moves of his hands and fingers. Although the general appears to be stable and featureless, the sharpness of his claws makes his moves suddenly more powerful! Everyone cheered and cheered.
The guard in black, however, was known for his agility and agility. His figure was seen coming and going in an erratic way. He did not fight Wanyuanbo to the death, but occasionally threw out one or two quick moves, but this made Wanyuanbo look a little in a hurry. After dozens of moves, everyone in the audience already knew what he was doing. At a glance, it was obvious that the black-clothed guard's kung fu was much higher, and he was deliberately teasing her like a mouse.
Traveling far away and experiencing dangerous situations, you naturally know it. But this man has a resolute personality. When he thinks that if King Jin is kidnapped today, all the family will be humiliated and his face will be lost, how can he retreat despite the difficulties. Then he tightened his strength and danced like crazy with his claws and punches. He ignored his own vitals and just concentrated on attacking.
Unconsciously, the two of them had taken fifty or sixty moves. Although Wan Yuanbo's attack was fierce, he was still unable to resist the agility and agility of the black-clothed guard. Even the clothes of the black-clad guard could hardly touch each other, and I felt cold in my heart, not to mention that if I saved King Jin today, I might even have to pay for my own life.
Anxious Wan Yuanbo was covered in sweat! As the saying goes, if you beat a snake but don't die, you will bring trouble to yourself.Its harm. Since it is death anyway, we have to throw ourselves into death and then survive, and put ourselves into death and then live. If we are lucky enough to end up with both sides injured, this life will not be in vain!
Wan Yuanbo has already prepared for the worst! He knew that today the blade had penetrated his chest and the fire was burning in his muscles, so he calmed down and calmed down. He was no longer as hasty as he was at first. Wan Yuanbo is the leader of the Haisha Gang. Although his martial arts skills are not high, his knowledge is extraordinary. He has his own understanding of the footwork and moves of other gangs. He had passed dozens of moves with the black-clothed guard and calmly memorized the black-clothed guard's footwork and body shape. Then he took advantage of the black-clothed guards' offensive and deliberately exploited a flaw, pretending to be exhausted and on the verge of retreating.
However, the guards in black were also attacked and rushed towards Wanyuanbo's arms as if nothing happened. Wan Yuanbo gritted his teeth secretly, turned out his claws, and grabbed the ghost-clothed guard's shoulders with both left and right claws with great force. With a "bang", a trace of black energy was squeezed out, and the left and right shoulders of the ghost-clothed guard suddenly collapsed! Wan Yuanbo's two claws were like grabbing a piece of deflated cloth bag!
Wan Yuanbo refused to stop once he succeeded. He was stunned for a moment, then increased his strength and squeezed with brute force! "Chi, chi..." The black air gradually dissipated, and Wan Yuanbo's left paw actually touched his right paw through the black cloak. And the lifeless black cloak drooped down, leaving only ten holes. Everyone in the audience was ecstatic! Cheers in unison!
The triumphant Wan Yuanbo grabbed the lifeless "black cloak" and smiled at Guiyi on the stage. But something shocking happened. Wan Yuanbo felt the soles of his feet suddenly tremble, and a crack opened under his feet with a pop. Before he had time to think about it, a mass of black energy split into two parts and wrapped around his left and right legs!
"Ah!" Wan Yuanbo screamed, and then he knelt on the ground, and a line of blood flowed down his trousers! It turned out that his legs had been broken! Then the black energy penetrated into the black cloak scattered on the ground and transformed into a human form again! Then he floated over slowly and leisurely, and stood in front of Wanyuanbo. The ghost-clothed guard snorted coldly, leaned over and tugged on the shoulder of the cloak, and the ten claw marks were clearly visible!
Wan Yuanbo raised his head and looked into the dark veil in horror. Inside the curtain hat set off by black gauze, two big white eyes suddenly lit up! Then two pairs of ghost claws suddenly came out from the black cloak and quickly clamped Wan Yuanbo's two wrists! Wan Yuanbo only felt that his fingers were like ten stylus pens, and as hot as fire. He was shocked. Just as he was about to shake off the ghost-clothed guard's claws with his elbow, he heard a "click" and his wrist bones had been crushed by the ghost-clothed guard.
Although his wrist was broken, Wan Yuanbo still endured the pain, roared angrily, and struck the black-clothed guard's temple with brute force with half a fist and half a claw with his right hand. The guards in black had already seen that he would have this trick. He dodged with a smile, then kicked out his right foot, hitting Wan Yuanbo in the belly. Everyone immediately saw a huge body flying out of the stage.
With a "bang", Wan Yuanbo fell to the ground. More than a dozen members of the Haisha Gang hurriedly stepped forward to help him up. They saw Wan Yuanbo's body slumping down, his face pale, and a mouthful of blood sprayed on the ground. Several ribs on his chest had been broken, and his internal organs had been injured! "Pfft!" Wan Yuanbo spurted out another mouthful of blood. Then he rolled his eyes, tilted his head, and was already dead!
Gui Yi nodded to his men and smiled slightly. Then he walked around and said: "Guarded in ghost clothes, conceived in the devil's coffin, bound by resentment, immortal!"
